name: ha-nova
description: AI-powered Home Assistant management through LLM coding agents
author: Markus Leben

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('nova/dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p nova/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:desktop:windows:headless: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL is required' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL is required' }; & './scripts/dev/windows-private-rc-install.ps1' -BundleUrl $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL -BundleSha256Url $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL }"
scripts.test:desktop:windows:rdp: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_CLIENT) { $env:HA_NOVA_CLIENT = 'claude' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL is required' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL is required' }; & './scripts/dev/windows-desktop-setup.ps1' -Client $env:HA_NOVA_CLIENT -BundleUrl $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL -BundleSha256Url $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL }"
scripts.test:bulk:fast: npm run test:safe -- tests/skills/bulk-audit-contract.test.ts tests/skills/review-contract.test.ts tests/skills/ha-entities-contract.test.ts tests/skills/ha-safety-contract.test.ts tests/skills/ha-nova-contract.test.ts tests/e2e/codex-skill-bulk-live-validator.test.ts
scripts.test:bulk:release: npm run test:bulk:fast && npm run test:bulk:smoke && npm run test:safe
scripts.verify: npm run verify:release-metadata && npm run typecheck && npm run test:safe && npm run build && bash scripts/check-docs.sh && npm run test:cli
scripts.release:rc:local: goreleaser build --snapshot --clean && bash scripts/release/build-install-bundle.sh && bash scripts/release/build-winget-manifest.sh
